Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x2048 pixels with 5% safe margin. Medium close-up, eye-level, portrait-lens feel. Camera is from the opposite side of Kyle’s dining table facing Bram, locked-off shot. Focus on Bram’s dry expression while holding a soup spoon. Leave quiet empty space in the upper right for a speech balloon, and also preserve visually quiet negative space at left 54%, top 4%, width 37%, height 22%. No text.

Subject: Bram Waldhart occupies left 25%, top 18%, width 48%, height 67%, foreground. He is seated at the table in front of a soup bowl, broad middle-aged build, brown hair with gray at the temples, short beard, no cloak, forest-green doublet. Pose: seated before soup, one eyebrow slightly raised. Expression: deadpan realistic joke, understated humor. Gaze toward Kyle off-camera. Action: answers while pausing mid-motion with the spoon. Preserve rugged fatherly presence, restrained beard detail and subtle eye wrinkles.

Background: Walt Fort dining hall, using the provided room only as background-space reference. Behind Bram are a low fireplace and dark wall, with the dining table and soup bowl in foreground. Stable horizontal table perspective. Depth layers: soup bowl foreground, Bram midground, fireplace and stone wall background. Lighting is soft indoor evening light, not dramatic firelight. Palette: forest green, wood browns, gray stone. Clean organized 2D character acting, polished webtoon illustration.

Mood: sparse, fatherly deadpan humor that punctures Kyle’s boast with a realistic joke. Continuity: screen direction right-to-left; Kyle has just finished boasting, and Bram’s joke is landing. Avoid speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, cloak, overly luxurious noble clothing, and any readable letters.
